cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
cards.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've broken your graduation mug. I've decided this is the lesson in letting go we both needed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I at least glue the handle back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Permission denied. Your urge to repair it shows why the lesson was necessary.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then may I have your graduation mug?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Granted. Losing mine will teach me generosity. You may choose our jam jars; I shall approve the larger one for you.
